source.citation: Krutyanskiy et al., PRL 130, 213601 (2023); Bennett et al., PRL 76, 722 (1996); Deutsch et al., PRL 77, 2818 (1996); Ballance et al., PRL 117, 060504 (2016); Myerson et al., PRL 100, 200502 (2008); Dhara et al., PRA 105, 022623 (2022)

component_sources.role: raw telecom trapped-ion link, memory, local swap, and rate projection
calcium-ion local one- and two-qubit operation fidelities and durations
calcium-ion fluorescence readout fidelity and duration
fixed-ion-resource spatially and temporally multiplexed dual-species repeater architecture

source.mapping_status: near-term component composition; not an end-to-end demonstrated repeater chain

validity.distance_semantics: distance between neighboring ion nodes; the photonic Bell station is at the midpoint
validity.route_scope: fixed-resource near-term composite evaluated only within the raw-link source's 1--50 km v1 range

hardware.resource_semantics: each internal node has four independent purifier lanes per adjacent edge; every lane reserves two memory ions and two communication ions, consumes two raw pairs into one accepted purified pair, and maintains at most one live output. Four is a fixed profile choice, not a per-route target-availability optimizer
hardware.resource_source: bounded multi-ion extension of the dual-species multiplexed repeater architecture analyzed by Dhara et al.; their resource study explicitly analyzes tens to hundreds of communication/memory ions per node (including 170 communication and 55 memory ions in a reported 150 km operating example), but this exact 16+16-ion Krutyanskiy composite was not demonstrated

rate_model.published_formula: raw T_link=(L/c'+T0)/[(P_link^0)^2 eta_t^2]; purified edge renewal adds E[max(G1,G2)] raw rounds, noisy-recurrence acceptance, local operation time, and one-way classical parity comparison
rate_model.raw_projection_validation_target: without purification, 16 links x 50 km gives about 0.71 s under Supplementary Eq. S12
rate_model.approximation_uncertainty: the balanced controller above purified elementary links generalizes rather than claims the source's raw-link-only S12 prediction

state_model.raw_published_validation_target: 16 unpurified links give final Bell fidelity 0.61 when memory decoherence is neglected
state_model.elementary_channel: phase-error Bell mixture from Krutyanskiy Supplementary Eqs. S13--S14
state_model.local_swap_channel: single-output-qubit depolarizing map from Krutyanskiy Supplementary Eq. S15

local_two_qubit_gate_model.fidelity_semantics: reported two-qubit gate fidelity central value; explicitly mapped to a d=4 Pauli channel, p=5(1-F_avg)/4

local_single_qubit_gate_model.fidelity_semantics: reported randomized-benchmarking average single-qubit gate fidelity; explicitly mapped to a d=2 Pauli channel, p=3(1-F_avg)/2
local_single_qubit_gate_model.source: Ballance et al., PRL 117, 060504 (2016), 0.066(3)e-3 error at 7.5 us

measurement_model.source: Myerson et al., PRL 100, 200502 (2008), adaptive 40Ca+ readout reaches 99.99% in 145 us average
measurement_model.mapping: readout bit confusion changes accept/reject post-selection probabilities; it is not applied as output depolarization

classical_comparison_model.distance_semantics: one full neighboring-node edge length; local operations at Alice and Bob execute in parallel

quality_restoration.unmodeled_local_effect: species-selective sacrificial-ion detection crosstalk onto retained memory is not assigned an invented channel; the profile requires a dual-species/multi-zone implementation and reports this as a remaining component-integration uncertainty

storage_decoherence_model.coherence_time_definition: enhanced-node Gaussian memory parameter used by the raw-link source's separate one-repeater secret-key-rate model
storage_decoherence_model.source: Krutyanskiy et al. Supplementary Section IV B parameter vector

memory_model.decay_semantics: the spin-qubit memory has no natural spontaneous-decay loss in the selected node abstraction
memory_model.purification_wait_semantics: the exact two-geometric-mode wait-gap distribution is averaged through the Gaussian coherence law on both sacrificial-pair memories before the recurrence circuit
memory_model.long_chain_warning: 0.63 s is retained rather than silently replacing it with an ideal or tens-of-seconds memory

controller_model.accepted_output_alive_time_semantics: fixed controller staleness cutoff measured from purified-pair pool acceptance; selected to remain well inside the 0.63 s Gaussian memory scale and validated, not assumed, against 1--50 km links through 16 hops
controller_model.scheduling: four parallel purifier lanes per edge, two-mode raw-pair generation within each lane, one purified output buffer per lane, and balanced nested local deterministic Bell swapping

notes: This profile is a transparent near-term composite, not a claim that one experiment combined all components. Its quantum-quality restoration is a full noisy two-copy LOCC instrument, while rate loss, post-selection, fixed ion inventory, sacrificial-pair wait decoherence, gate/readout durations, and classical comparison are explicit. Encoded/error-corrected repeaters are intentionally not activated because one bounded recurrence round is sufficient to restore zero-age 12- and 16-link CHSH violation under the declared component model.
